---
title: Home
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          # An announcement alone opens the fixed header (Q1's
          # `nav.announcement` term), whatever its position.
          - 'header#quarto-header #quarto-announcement.alert.alert-primary'
        -
          - 'nav.navbar'
          # Not dismissable: no close control.
          - '#quarto-announcement .quarto-announcement-action'
          # Q1 adds `nav-fixed` only for a header containing a navbar.
          - 'body.nav-fixed'
---

A site whose only header content is the announcement.
